column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
args.test.ts: every grammar rule and error kind with its sentence and suggestion, the help text, type inference with negative controls, random declarations written into command lines and parsed back
commands.test.ts: a tree resolved to its verb, help asked at every level, unknown words with suggestions, help rendered from the declaration
palette.test.ts: the palette's roles, marks and their ASCII fallbacks, colour only where allowed
width.test.ts: wide characters and escape sequences, a line cut by display width, never inside a grapheme or an escape sequence
vt.test.ts: the terminal emulator's sequences, scrolling, wide characters and a cut line that never wraps
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the tarball and runs every entry on Node 26 and Bun and type-checks a consumer
guide-model.test.ts: each kind decoded, every refusal (unknown field, unknown kind, missing and mistyped field, a field of another kind) with its path
guide-caps.test.ts: the levels for a TTY, a pipe, NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, CI, a small terminal, a forced level and a Windows terminal
guide-render.test.ts: snapshots of every kind at the three levels, every line within the columns, no escape in plain, wide characters wrapped whole
guide-driver.test.ts: a question with a validation retry, a run with its result, a wait polled with a fake clock and backoff, plain waits, a time limit, an invalid step
guide-driver.test.ts: a human gate released by Enter or by the value typed, refused on input that is not a TTY, an input that ends, lines ended by CRLF, CR and LF
guide-driver.test.ts: a secret field refused before anything is written or read
guide-driver.test.ts: an abort while waiting, while asking and in full, the terminal restored and status 130
guide-screen.test.ts: the layout on the emulator of vt, no row scrolls, a resize redrawn, the fallback to ansi and back
guide-process.test.ts runs one script under Bun and under Node 26 with piped input of CRLF lines; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the packed entry
guide-render.test.ts: a UUID kept whole at 41 and 60 columns, a longer token cut, CRLF text and narrow widths

guide-resume.test.ts: the count as a position that never falls, a resumed run ticked from the first frame, [x] [>] [ ] [!], a long plan scrolled; guide-pass2.test.ts: a resume at 60x24 with done and skipped ([-]), the count kept at a step outside the plan
guide-resume.test.ts: the status line for a question, an acknowledgement, a confirmation, a verb at work and the end
guide-resume.test.ts: a 24-row screen with a long step keeps the summary on top, the prompt at the bottom and a (more marker
guide-resume.test.ts: a step given again is shown once in plain and in full, and the pane holds the current step only
guide-resume.test.ts: one transcript after the screen is left, a failure once, reported on every error; guide-pass2.test.ts: the last five steps, the failure and the closing line
guide-pass2.test.ts: the command whole beside the failure at 60x24 and 100x30 and 30 rows, the prompt wrapped to the pane, the evidence clipped first, fitPane priorities
guide-pass2.test.ts: a label as it is, the caller's short, the words that fit and ~, a first word cut with ~
guide-pass2.test.ts: the footer with the elapsed time and the dimmed last line in full on vt, the plain lines every 15 seconds, progress scrubbed to one line, the ticker ended with the work
